summary.text: Matt Lehman is a Democratic state representative from Kentucky who has represented District 67 since 2025 and is seeking re-election to the Kentucky House of Representatives in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists him as Matthew Lehman, co-founder and CEO of Koligo Therapeutics.

paragraphs.text: Matt Lehman, listed by Ballotpedia as Matthew Lehman, was born in Fort Thomas, Kentucky, and graduated from Covington Catholic High School.
He earned a B.A. from the University of Louisville in 1999 and an M.S. from Columbia University in 2002.
His career experience includes co-founding and working as CEO of Koligo Therapeutics.
Lehman assumed office on January 1, 2025, succeeding Rachel Roberts (D).
In the 2025-2026 session he served on the Economic Development & Workforce Investment, State Government, Small Business & Information Technology, and Transportation committees.
